name: Super Cub Cockpit
description: The smell of avgas and old leather. The panel glows with warm amber light — six-pack instruments in a row, steam gages with needles that quiver. The yoke is worn smooth. Through the windshield, the world tilts as you bank. Far below, the runway is a thin grey stripe getting wider. Your passengers are quiet in the back seat, watching. The radio crackles.
notes: Feel the seat — it tells you what the gages haven't shown yet
Rates of change matter more than absolute values
The wind is not your enemy, it's just reality pushing back
